description: This file defines the RequestResponseArgs class in the Slim Framework, implementing an invocation strategy that calls a route handler with request, response, and route parameters as individual arguments.

classes.name: RequestResponseArgs
classes.description: Implements an invocation strategy that invokes a route callable with request, response, and route parameters as individual arguments.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the given callable with request, response, and route arguments unpacked as individual arguments, returning the response.
